title: The Point of the Race
subtitle: 体育与运动 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 体育与运动（生活与学习·运动与健身）
meta: 主题语境：体育与运动（生活与学习·运动与健身）　|　核心词汇：point　|　正文 306 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 point 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: Every April our school holds a 24-hour relay, and last year I was the slowest runner in my class. For weeks I could not see the ① point of taking part: only three teams would win anything, so why run all night just to lose?

My coach did not argue. She took me to watch the girls' team train — the team that had won three years running. What struck me was not their speed but their notes. After every session each runner wrote one sentence about the exact ② point where the baton had slipped or where a turn had cost them a second. Their notes had a ③ point that mine never had: they recorded the reason, not the feeling.

On the night of the relay, rain turned the track into a shallow river. At the ④ point when our third runner handed over the baton, we were two laps behind. Nobody blamed her. Our captain ⑤ pointed at the far bend and said, 'That is where we win next year.' Then she ⑥ pointed out that we had cut four minutes off our own record, even though the scoreboard showed nothing at all.

We finished sixth. Six teams had more ⑦ points than ours on that board. In the changing room, however, the coach ⑧ made a point of reading our notes aloud, one by one, in front of everyone. Each sentence was short and to the ⑨ point: what went wrong, and what to change. Nobody argued about the score; we argued about the second we had lost.

This year I am still not fast. But I know the ⑩ point of the race now. It is not the points on the board; it is the habit of looking honestly at the place where you lost a second. Medals end up in a cupboard. That habit will outlast every one of them.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 要点；核心意思
C. n. 意义；目的；理由
D. n. （具体的）点；环节；位置
H. 固定搭配：make a point of doing 特意做；to the point 简明切题

items.q: the exact point where the baton had slipped
had a point that mine never had
At the point when our third runner handed over
pointed out that we had cut four minutes
made a point of reading our notes aloud
I know the point of the race now

answers.why: 句首 could not see ... of taking part，后面用 why 反问，说的是“参加的意义”，取“意义；目的；理由”。
被 exact 修饰，后接 where 引导的定语从句，指交接棒出问题的那个具体环节，取“具体的点”。
their notes had a point ... that mine never had，指笔记里有一层“要点、道理”是我没有的。
At the point when + 时间状语从句，表示“在……的那一刻”，取“时刻；关头”。
pointed at + 具体事物 the far bend，是“用手指示方向”的动作，取动词“指；指向”。
pointed out that + 从句，是“指出（一个事实）”，取“指出；说明”，注意与第 5 题的 at 区分。
more points than ours 与 scoreboard 呼应，指比赛中的得分，取“分数”。
make a point of doing sth 是固定搭配，意为“特意做某事”，这里指教练特意把笔记念出来。
to the point 是固定搭配，意为“简明切题”，与 short 并列，说明句子短而说到要害。
与第 1 题呼应，I know the point of the race 指“现在我明白了这场比赛的意义”。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 我起初不明白参加接力赛有什么意义。（the point of）
教练指出了我们交接棒时出问题的地方。（point out）
她在比赛里得了十八分。（points）
他的发言简短而切题。（to the point）
我们的队长特意在训练后等最慢的那名队员。（make a point of）
他指着跑道边的计时牌说，我们快了四分钟。（point at）
answers: At first I did not see the point of joining the relay race.
The coach pointed out where we had gone wrong in handing over the baton.
She scored eighteen points in the match.
His speech was short and to the point.
Our captain made a point of waiting for the slowest runner after training.
He pointed at the timing board beside the track and said that we had been four minutes faster.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 point 的 3 种不同用法；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: When I first joined the school team, I could not see the point of training in the rain.
Our coach pointed out that every athlete keeps a record of the point where he lost a second.
In the last match I scored only four points, but my speed had improved.
She made a point of running one extra lap after everybody else had left the track.
A marathon is not won by speed alone, and that is the point I want to make here.
So long as we continue to look honestly at our weak points, the team will get better every year.
